slides.h1: Big Career Moves Rarely Come Out of Nowhere. They Line Up With a Dasha.
slides.sub: How a well-placed Mahadasha-Antardasha pairing tends to coincide with a career inflection.

slides.body: A career breakout tends to arrive when the running Mahadasha and Antardasha (planetary period and sub-period) both connect to the 10th house or its lord.
The periods' planets are dignified, supported in the D-10 (career divisional chart) and linked to the 10th, 11th or their lords. Dasha timing needs a promise underneath it.
The Mahadasha sets the theme for years. The Antardasha picks the window within it. Inflection points tend to sit where both point at the same house.
This is a pattern, not a claim about a real person's chart. Public birth times are often unverified, so we do not pin this to a named example.

slides.h2: Look for it in your own chart
points: Name your current Mahadasha and Antardasha
Check each planet's link to the 10th or 11th house
Note when the next Antardasha begins
